title: Hussain ibne ali ka
body:
hussain ibne ali ka gham dil e muztar mein rehta hai
bahar unwaan jaise ghar ka maalik ghar mein rehta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
ghame shabbir aur hubbe ali hai zindagi apni
ye jazba dil mein rehta hai ye sauda sar mein rehta hai
hussain ibne ali ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
sunega poochne waale taharat deeda e tar ki
ye aansu sayyeda ke gosha e chadar mein rehta hai
hussain ibne ali ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
kisi surat ali ke dar pe rehne ki jagah milti
ye khursheed e ziya gustar isi chakkar mein rehta hai
hussain ibne ali ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
nikalta hi nahi bughze ali dushman ke seene se
ye marhab doosra hai jo isi khyber mein rehta hai
hussain ibne ali ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
faraari se na ye poocho ke aakhir bhaagta kyun hai
ye poocho bhagna tay hai to kyun lashkar mein rehta hai
hussain ibne ali ka gham...
<<DIVIDER>>
kabhi pehlu mein dhoonda aur kabhi royi rabab uth kar
ye aalam raat bhar yaad e ali asghar mein rehta hai
hussain ibne ali ka gham...
author: Mustafa Jauhar
